query: SELECT p.id FROM managed_publications p JOIN managed_distribution_outbox o ON o.publication_id=p.id AND o.owner_id=p.owner_id JOIN managed_distribution_deliveries d ON d.outbox_id=o.id AND d.owner_id=p.owner_id AND d.status='distributed' WHERE p.owner_id=$1 AND p.resource_id=$2 AND p.generation=$3
